description: This file declares the MediaKeysCapabilities class and the MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory class, which are part of the Rialto media server implementation. It defines interfaces for media key capabilities, including supported key systems and version support, and includes factory methods for creating instances.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating MediaKeysCapabilities instances, implementing IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements IMediaKeysCapabilities, providing information about supported key systems and their versions.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
methods.description: Default constructor for the factory class.

methods.name: ~MediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
methods.description: Default destructor for the factory class.

methods.name: getMediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IMediaKeysCapabilities instance.

methods.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
methods.description: Constructor initializing with IOcdmFactory and IOcdmSystemFactory shared pointers.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system identifiers.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
